--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,31 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
+    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
+        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
+    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
+    if n_candidates == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Empty input matrix")
+    if not (np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() and np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() and np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()):
+        raise ValueError("All values must be finite")
+    if (logp_with_result > 0).any() or (logp_call_only > 0).any() or (logp_no_call > 0).any():
+        raise ValueError("All values must be nonpositive")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid threshold: boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")
+
+    loss_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    keep_mask = (loss_with_result < loss_no_call + tau_filter) & (loss_with_result < loss_call_only)
+
+    margins = np.minimum(loss_no_call - loss_with_result, loss_call_only - loss_with_result)
+
+    return (keep_mask, margins)
